notes: Singles tennis with standard scoring on a marked court is Sports, and space-bounded is the genre default for exactly this: baselines and sidelines as a rigid perimeter with play contained inside. Court Sport is the matching preset — out detection is trigger-bounds, the in-court landing halves are the scoring planes, and the serve boxes are the play-start positions. The answer rules out a stadium, so I dropped all the dressing options and left the court on an open bright backdrop, which keeps the whole build on P0 with no tiered seating. The net is real geometry with no option row of its own; it rides along as a detail, and the court itself is a regulation template better placed parametrically than drawn, which is a generator choice rather than a routing one.
